blockNote: The two people of Servas's dream (file offsets 1024571-1025088, SNES $1F:A23B-$A43F): the father and the son (Servas) on the sinking ghost ship, in the dream scene A09S02 that the Dream Rod opens at the napping dolphin (se_npc_dolphin_servas_dream_0F8000). Both are plain placement scripts without a lair switch: they stand there for the dream.
=== ROSTER ===

- se_npc_servas_father_0FA23B: walking onto tile ($04,$29) replays the overheard talk ('You can hear the conversation of a father and son. Daddy, how many days have passed since the ship sank? I am too hungry and cannot travel any farther. Are we going to die? Servas, my son, some people believe that human life does not end at death. They believe that they will be born into a new life. Lives, they feel, are everlasting.'); talking to him: 'Oh, I hear some voices ... maybe the Master is calling me.' and flag $0000 is set.

- se_npc_servas_son_0FA3A5: Servas. Before the father has spoken (flag $0000 clear) only '--------'. After: 'Someone is calling me. What is that? I just put one GEM in a treasure chest. I hope someone will find it. --------', then COP 10 to A06S01 at pixel ($C0,$40) (the dream ends at the doorstep of the dolphin's house) and flag $0704 is set (the dolphin of the first half then only says that he always has the same dream).
=== EVENT FLAGS ===
$0000 the father has spoken, $0704 the dream was lived to the end.
=== OPEN ===
The walkthrough (Boss Preparation) says Servas 'will note a 1-Gem treasure he placed'; the ROM text says he put one GEM in a treasure chest; the chest itself is not in this block.

blockNote: The actors of the St. Elles coast scenes that stand apart from the seabed (file offsets 1025088-1025172, 1025268-1025436, 1025471-1025611 and 1025953-1025988, SNES $1F:A440-$A493, $A4F4-$A59B, $A5BF-$A64A and $A7A1-$A7C3): the 200 EXP fairy gem, the shared return prompt of all fairies, the pyramid hint fairy, the hot coals, the volcano of Durean with the spot where the Mermaid's Tears are poured, and the BG2 scroll follower.
=== ROSTER ===
- se_npc_fairy_exp_200_0FA440: switch $A6, flag $1D00. A fairy gem that pays 200 EXP once ('I am watching over the world. Here, take this. [the hero] received EXP!'), then asks the return prompt.

- se_npc_fairy_return_prompt_0FA46D: shared tail of every fairy of the chapter (the 300 and 250 EXP fairies of se_seabed_of_st_elles_actors jump here too): 'Would you like to return to the Seabed Palace?' with a Stay / Go back menu: Go back: 'Allright, good luck.' and COP 10 to A06S01 at pixel ($1F8,$200); Stay: 'Visit me again when you are ready.'

- se_npc_fairy_pyramid_hint_0FA4F4: switch $B8 (meta type $54). The fairy of the lightning pyramids: 'The monuments on this island are lightning pyramids. If you wear the Thunder Ring and touch them, the Master will send down lightning to destroy the monsters.' then the return prompt.
- se_obj_durean_hot_coals_0FA5BF: meta type $55. The hot coals of the volcanic island: standing on metatile $47 costs 4 HP per check, with no armor test, until flag $0503 (the volcano is out) is set.

- se_obj_durean_volcano_0FA5D6: meta type $07. The crater of Durean: spawns the spot where the Tears are poured and animates the smoking crater until flag $0503; then it shows the extinguished frame and ends.

- se_obj_durean_tears_spot_0FA5FA: spawned by the volcano. When the hero stands on tile ($1F,$21) with the Mermaid's Tears (item $21) equipped: flag $0503 is set, the Tears are used up and '[the hero] poured out the mermaid's tears.' is shown (walkthrough: the Mermaid's Tears turn the magma of Durean to stone).
- se_effect_bg2_scroll_follow_0FA7A1: meta type $2F, a scroll actor for BG2.
=== EVENT FLAGS ===
$1D00 the 200 EXP were paid, $0503 the volcano of Durean is out (read by Kanna, the Tears mermaid, the vents and the hot coals), $0001 the pour text has been shown (read by the volcano).
=== OPEN ===
The tile $47 of the coals resolves part of OQ-I031-2: the scene is Durean and the walkthrough names the coals; see OQ-I036-6.

partNotes.w2_effect_player_overlay_0FA6F5:
The player overlay (meta type $30).

When: placement script of the world 2 scenes that use it; runs every frame.
Sees: spawns the helpers b and a (COP 85), then each frame picks an animation number from the hero's state: subframe_active set: $20; otherwise by the hero's speeds ($04 = x, $06 = y): x negative $26, x positive $28, else y negative $24, y positive $22, still $20. It moves helper a (the previous actor link of this actor) onto the hero (x, y + 1) and helper b onto the hero (x, y), and restarts a helper's animation (step $14 = 0) only when its number changes; helper b uses the number + 1.
In: X = D = slot.
Out: RTL; X restored (PHX / PLX).
Clobbers: A, Y, DP $00.
